reason: We have no car right now, so getting to Tawfeer MAX means a taxi or asking someone for a lift. If the Tawfeer prices are real and I only pay $1.25 a bag, that is cheaper than a ride. The first bag has no fee, so I will try it and check the slip against the receipt.
objection: Another fee on top of my groceries. I need to see on the slip that I really pay less than at my village mini-market, or I will stop after a couple of bags.
would_change_my_mind: If the first slip shows my total is not clearly below the village mini-market price even after the $1.25, I would stop. A fee-free second bag would make me stay.
